reason: My register has never let me down, and this whole app is in English, so my staff and I would struggle with it. After losing two stylists last year, I am not going to push selfie check-ins and new phone work on the ones who stayed.
objection: It is only in English, and I trust my register more than any app. ₹999 every month, on top of ₹4,999, adds up for something my team may stop using after a week.
would_change_my_mind: If it was fully in Hindi and a salon owner I know nearby showed me it actually caught cash going missing from the drawer.
